name: Lindenderry at Red Hill
address: 142 Arthurs Seat Rd, Red Hill VIC 3937
signature: 40 acres of English-style gardens, a small estate vineyard, and the kind of country-house feel the Peninsula doesn't offer anywhere else.
editorNote:
Lindenderry is the quiet, unflashy option on the Red Hill plateau, and for many travellers it is the best one. A Lancemore property set on 40 acres of English-style gardens with its own small estate vineyard, its sensibility is country-house rather than design hotel. The weekend rhythm is set by the rose garden, the pool, and a restaurant that doesn't try to be anything other than what it is, which, at this price point and in this setting, is exactly the right call.

Rooms are comfortable and traditional, with suites that run to the garden. Breakfast on the terrace is one of the Peninsula's reliable quiet pleasures. The cellar door and tasting program are run with real care, and the estate sits conveniently close to the Merricks cellar-door cluster for anyone who wants to build a day around it.

Choose Lindenderry when you want a weekend that lets you decompress rather than perform. It is not trying to be Jackalope, and it is better for it.
whyWeGo: When the brief is decompress rather than perform, Lindenderry is the Peninsula hotel that gets that distinction right.
ifOnlyOneThing: Book a garden suite, take breakfast on the terrace in the morning, and plan one cellar-door walk through the estate vineyard before you leave.
